---
title: Hospital admissions to death registrations
---

## Question

Which hospital admissions can be linked to a later death registration so follow-up and mortality outcomes are complete?

## Data

Synthetic admissions and death records modelled on a state linkage-unit workflow. Person-level fields are generated in-script because an equivalent public person dataset is not appropriate.

## Linkage strategy

Use broad blocking on year of birth and sex, compare names and dates with tolerated errors, then apply one-to-one resolution with manual review for the middle score band.

## Result

The walkthrough shows how small identifier errors propagate into missed links if blocking is too tight.

## Reporting

State that the records are synthetic, describe the generator, and report the blocking, comparison, threshold, and one-to-one resolution rules used in `R/app-01-hospital-deaths.R`.
